Q: How to calculate the area of irregular shapes programmatically? A:

You could partition the irregular polygon into smaller polygons with known area formulas, for instance by triangulation.

Q: Merging two A5 pages into a singe A4 page (without using pdfnup) A:

You can do it with a combination of Ghostscript and pdftk.

Here's how: Chop pages of PDF documents into multiple pages.

The above linked example shows how to split pages into half. Just modify the steps accordingly, using different parameters to...

  • ...first move "left" pages to a double-sized canvas, left half;
  • ...then move "right" pages to a double-sized canvas, right half;
  • ...last, combine the pages with pdftk.

Hint: You'd want to use either of pdftk's multistamp or multibackground operations (NOT: its shuffle operation!) to get the wanted final result.

Q: How to use overlayColor in TabBar in flutter? A:

You can use this snippet code to change overlayColor:

overlayColor: MaterialStateProperty.all<Color>(Colors.transparent),

Update:

MaterialStateProperty had been deprecated after v3.19.0-0.3.pre

Use WidgetStateProperty instead.

overlayColor: WidgetStateProperty.all<Color>(Colors.transparent),

Q: How do I change the footprint variable? A:

Beyond the corrections commented on, I think that the structure itself deserves a "touch-up".

footprint = 0

  # we avoid creating variables in a single use
if input( "Do you have a pet (yes/no)? " ) == "yes":

      # if you have a pet, you update the value of "footprint"
    footprint += 5
 
      # only if you have pets ask about their food
    if input( "Does your pet food contain meat (yes/no)?" ) == "yes":
        footprint += 10

days = int( input( "How many days a week do you commute to school or work? " ))

if days > 0:
    transport = input( "Do you commute by foot, bike, bus, train, or car? " )

    # only if we move, do we verify what type of transport we do it in
    # Different methods of transportation have different environmental impacts.
    if transport == "car":
        footprint += 8 * days
    elif transport == "bus" or transport == "train":

          # correct it
        footprint += 4 * days

    # we do not use an "else" as the remaining
    # options (bike and foot) are not polluting... 
    # unless you haven't bathed :)

Q: Cannot return null for non-nullable field Mutation.createAds graphql error A:

I haven't tested your code, but in my case I got this error when in my no-sql database I had one wrong field name in one document. The error disappeared and the code worked when I corrected this field name in the database.

An another reson for this error: I had missing fields in the documents of a no-sql collection, especially in the case of a field, namely address, that are marked as required fields in the GraphQL schema:

type Person {
   name: String!
   phone: String
   address: Address!
   id: ID!
   }

Q: array_map(): Argument #2 ($array) must be of type array, int given this error is showing A:

The problem is with this piece of code from your ProductController:

            'user_ID' => auth()->user()->id,

It errors because instead of a validation rule you have the actual user ID there.

I'm assuming you wanted the user ID to be the current user ID and wanted to validate that, you can but not like this.

If you want to be sure the user_id from your input is always the authenticated user ID use this:

$input = $request->all();
$input['user_id'] = auth()->user()->id;

The error is because the user ID is probably an integer value, if we look at the code where the error occurred ValidationRuleParser:92 you can see it checks for a string and object and otherwise passes the unmodified value to array_map, since you pass an integer it gives you the error you are seeing. Bit of a tricky one to figure out but the stack trace should have included a frame originating from your controller, specifically the $request->validate call.

Although technically not part of your question I want to warn about using $request->all() since this could potentially introduce extra data that is passed to your model without it being validated or intended. Instead use $request->validated() to get only the validated values. You also have $fillable set on your models, so it's not an immediate issue but I would still recommend only pass in validated fields just in case $fillable is expanded but the validation rules are not.
